consistency_log.description: Terminology consistency — canonical technical terms, methodology names, and acronyms across all three sections
consistency_log.source_basis: Tier 3 objectives.json (canonical component/system names in objective titles); all three section artifacts. Key terms verified: Route B / homogeneous-patch proxy, Route A / direct probabilistic fusion, AquaCrop, water-use efficiency (WUE), ERA5, PlanetScope, Sentinel-1 SAR, Sentinel-2, TRL 3-4, RQ1-RQ10. OBJ-1 title uses 'latent field state' while WP1 title uses 'field state' — this is a canonical intentional distinction applied consistently across all three sections, not a terminology drift.

consistency_log.description: Section ordering and completeness — all three Part B sections present in correct order
consistency_log.source_basis: All three criterion-aligned section artifacts present with confirmed schema IDs; section order Excellence(1) → Impact(2) → Implementation(3) matches MSCA-PF application form template structure

consistency_log.description: Traceability footer consistency — non-empty primary_sources and no_unsupported_claims_declaration consistent with validation_status
consistency_log.source_basis: excellence_section.json traceability_footer (no_unsupported_claims_declaration: true; overall_status: inferred — no conflict); impact_section.json traceability_footer (no_unsupported_claims_declaration: true; overall_status: inferred — no conflict); implementation_section.json traceability_footer (no_unsupported_claims_declaration: true; overall_status: inferred — no conflict). No section has no_unsupported_claims_declaration: true combined with overall_status: unresolved. All primary_sources arrays non-empty.

consistency_log.description: Validation status aggregation — record overall_status from each section; note any unresolved status as cross-section concern
consistency_log.source_basis: excellence_section.json validation_status.overall_status: inferred; impact_section.json validation_status.overall_status: inferred; implementation_section.json validation_status.overall_status: inferred. No section has overall_status: unresolved. All three sections carry inferred status driven by synthesis-provenance claims (not unverified or contradicted), consistent with CLAUDE.md §12.2 vocabulary.
